serviceAreas.name: Union NJ
serviceAreas.description: JZ Home Improvement has proudly served Union, NJ, for over three decades, rooted deeply in the local community where owner Jacek Machnik resides. Combining European-trained electrical precision with 30 years of American contracting experience, we specialize in transforming Union's diverse residential properties, from classic Cape Cods to modern expansions. We handle the entire renovation lifecycle, expertly navigating Union Township municipal building codes and permitting requirements to guarantee stress-free completions. Our deep roots in the community mean we don't just work here—we partner with local suppliers to secure premium materials at fair, transparent price points. By delivering top-tier craftsmanship without premium markups, we have built a business sustained entirely by word-of-mouth recommendations and lifelong customer loyalty. From complete kitchen overhauls to finished basements, we are committed to elevating your home's value while keeping your project on time and within budget.
serviceAreas.short_description: Based right in Union, NJ, JZ Home Improvement delivers 30 years of expert, European-trained home remodeling. Enjoy fair pricing, exceptional local craftsmanship, and stress-free permitting for your next home renovation.
highlights: Deeply rooted Union, NJ business with 30 years of localized municipal code expertise
European-trained technical precision delivering premium renovations at highly competitive, fair pricing
Active community partner regularly connecting clients with vetted, trusted local specialists
